object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: In a git repository of PARENT and CHILD, acknowledge CHILD-1's link to PARENT-1, then change PARENT-1 and commit, so the link is a suspect link. In the repository's .git folder, store a record of link states, as an earlier run of the GUI or MCP server stores it, that says PARENT-1 last changed at the acknowledged commit, so the link would read OK. Run mellon-check. Expected: exit status 1 and a line for the suspect link CHILD-1 -> PARENT/PARENT-1; the stored record is byte for byte as it was.
